label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

@Lorna Villaruz MY BEST FRIEND IS COMING TO LIVERPOOL!!! 🎉🎉🎉 And her NMC PIN came through TODAY!!! 🙏

Lorna, I cannot even type properly, my hands are shaking. After all the papers and the waiting and the praying, it is finally here. You are officially a registered nurse in the UK, and you are coming to ME. Twenty years I have been telling you, come here, come here, and now look at you 😭❤️

1996, Iloilo, our capping ceremony. Same hairstyle, same dream, same white shoes that we polished every single night in the dorm. And you always borrowing my shoe polish and never buying your own, ha? Twenty-nine years later and I still have not forgotten that 😂 Sige lang, I forgive you.

Then you went to Riyadh, then Dubai, almost 18 years of caring for other people's families while your own family was far away. I know how that feels.

2004 I left for UK and you cried at the airport and said "susunod ako, I will follow you." Susunod nga. 22 years later, it is really happening. I am crying again typing this haha.

And she did her OSCE in Nottingham, and I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows exactly what she is getting into 😂 No turning back now, bebs.

Here is the timetable so everybody knows. Lorna lands 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, around 1pm. She starts 25 January on Ward 7 medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, induction first then the preceptorship. Ward 7, you are lucky, you have no idea. She is the best nurse I know. Calm in a crisis, never rattles, the patients love her, the kind of nurse you want beside you when things go wrong. I would know, I trained with her.

First month she stays with us. Spare room is sorted, Ben says ok (he said yes before I even finished the sentence haha). Andrea's boxes are getting cleared out this weekend, heater is ready, thick duvet is ready. Lorna, bring dried mangoes, bring the Bicol pili for Tito Ben, and bring a PROPER COAT. Not the one from Divisoria. Liverpool wind is no joke, I have lost three umbrellas this year alone 🌧️

And know this. You are not arriving alone. You have me, you have Ben, you have the whole Filipino family here. The Christmas parties, the Simbang Gabi at St Teresa's next year, you will be there with us, nine nights, no excuses. When I came in 2004 nobody told me anything — I paid the wrong bill for 3 months, haha — so I am telling you everything. Every form, every bank account, every bus, I will be there.

My sister from another mother. Ang tagal nating hinintay ito.

Welcome home, Lorna. Liverpool is ready for you ❤️🇵🇭🇬🇧

reasons: It says 'Twenty-nine years later' for the 1996 capping ceremony, but 1996 to 2026 is 30 years.
